missing_clauses.name: Deposit Return Timeline
missing_clauses.why_it_matters: No timeframe specified for the landlord to refund the balance security deposit after vacating.

missing_clauses.name: Notice Before Landlord Inspection
missing_clauses.why_it_matters: No requirement for advance notice (e.g. 24 hours) before landlord entry, compromising privacy.

missing_clauses.name: Landlord Repair Timelines
missing_clauses.why_it_matters: No specific deadline for landlord to complete major structural or plumbing repairs.

inconsistencies.quote_b: providing 30 days' written notice to the Tenant
inconsistencies.description: Contradictory notice periods: Tenant must give 90 days notice, whereas Landlord can terminate with only 30 days notice.
